rulings.reason: The instruction scores topical subject matter -- whether the joke's referent is Reddit/karma/posting -- and says nothing about whether the joke is well-constructed or funny, so a high score is evidence about topic selection and in-group audience targeting, not about comedic quality. It is mixed because platform-reflexive jokes can also be genuinely funnier to this specific voting community, so the same upstream cause plausibly produces real quality alongside the audience-match effect.
